limitations: These profiles are diagnostic workloads, never replacements for the fixed normal 3+3+3 cohort.
Weighted sample intervals are wall-time observations, not exact CPU attribution. Large unsampled intervals can be attributed to the last frame by V8.
Chrome Profiler.start/stop encloses protocol/render work outside the measured transition function; envelope duration and transition.ms are different metrics.
One Chrome pair establishes sampled costs, not repeatability or a complete cause for the three-run Orders regression.
The server CPU diagnostic did not reproduce a >200 ms gap. It cannot explain or dismiss the normal 1,248 ms failure. No speculative production optimization or acceptance-threshold change follows.
